limits.detail: resolveMortal receives a trusted verified prior state. Its schema/genesis/immutable-definition guards cannot independently prove the complete provenance of mutable resources, HP, clocks or encounter history. The journal/storage verification path must supply that prefix.
Matching Principal fields is admission binding, not proof of external authentication. Host delivery and referee visible-situation/perception remain external responsibilities.
Correctness probes do not establish campaign balance, fairness perception, optimal strategy or experiential quality. The planned balance study remains necessary.
Ordinary-process probes cover targeted adversarial paths and a maximum-size encounter; they are not an exhaustive proof over all million-event histories or a statistical RNG test.
Short journal probes validate integration of the identical reducer only. This is not an independent exhaustive audit of storage, views, the balance harness or all assembled files.
